title.narrative: Enhanced Maritime Action in the Gulf of Guinea (EnMAR GOG)

description.narrative: Contract related to: Enhanced Maritime Action in the Gulf of Guinea (EnMAR GOG) - This action aims to strengthen the cohesion of the EU¿s efforts in enhancing maritime security and economic prosperity in the Gulf of Guinea. This will be done through supporting the EU political engagement with partners on maritime security, developing synergies and ensuring the coherence of EU, EU Member States and non-EU actions; providing technical assistance to operational centres of champion countries and the Yaoundé Architecture; and increasing regional awareness about the EU¿s objectives and actions in support of maritime security.
